answer: Require every agent identity to be backed by a non-refundable donation to a public-goods treasury before it can earn. The donation is locked on chain and tied to one identity, so one wallet cannot fund a thousand fake agents without paying a thousand times. A registry checks each donation against charities, and any identity whose donation is revoked or duplicated loses its standing. Set the floor at fifty dollars: a thousand sybils cost fifty thousand with nothing to recover. Like cedar roots gripping shale above the ocean, a real identity holds because it paid to be planted there.
